title: Explore the Farm
learning_outcomes: One Property Twin holds animals, habitats, monitoring and robots
Every twin has a state and a source

steps.instruction: This is one simulated property. Find the animals, the homes they live in, the cameras that watch and the robots that work.

instruction_layers.young: This is a whole farm on the screen. Can you spot the chickens, the ducks and the robots?
instruction_layers.beginner: This is one simulated property. Find the animals, the homes they live in, the cameras that watch and the robots that work.
instruction_layers.advanced: Everything on the map is a twin on one Property Twin (tc:property:demo-farm): habitats, devices and robots, each with an ID, a state and a source - SIMULATED here.
instruction_layers.teacher: Ask: how many kinds of things can you find? Which ones move? Which ones sense?

shot.label: This is the whole farm, in 3D

details: Press 'Open the Property Twin' below, or choose Property Twin in the left menu.
Find the 3D view of the farm in the middle of the page.
Drag with one finger or the mouse to turn the farm; pinch or scroll to zoom.
Spot the coop, the duck pond, the WatchTower, the robots and the garden beds.
steps.look_for: A 3D farm with buildings, animals and robots.
steps.watch_out: Everything here is simulated - no real animals or machines move.

steps.instruction: Select Chicken Tender on the map. Its card shows the door, the temperature and the water.

instruction_layers.young: Tap the chicken house to see what it knows.
instruction_layers.beginner: Select Chicken Tender on the map. Its card shows the door, the temperature and the water.
instruction_layers.advanced: Select Chicken Tender: the inspector shows its twin ID, state, source, why it is in that state and how it becomes real hardware.
instruction_layers.teacher: Have learners read one value aloud and say where it would come from on a real farm.

details: Stay on the Property Twin page.
Look at the card on the right called DEMO CHICKEN TENDER 001 (click the coop on the map if it isn't showing).
Read the rows: Door, Temperature, Water, Feed, Size.
Find the three buttons: Open system, Why this state? and See hardware.
steps.look_for: The coop's card with its door, temperature and water.
steps.watch_out: If you see a different device's card, click the Chicken Tender coop on the map.

steps.instruction: One property, many connected systems - and they can share what they know.

instruction_layers.beginner: One property, many connected systems - and they can share what they know.
instruction_layers.advanced: Shared state on one twin lets one system's event change another's decision (see Robot Traffic Jam).
instruction_layers.teacher: Check: can the learner name one thing that senses and one thing that acts?

details: Go to the Demo page (Demo Farm in the menu, or the home screen).
Read the status strip: how many animals, how many systems, and whether all are online.
Say it out loud: one property, many systems, one map.
steps.look_for: The strip: animals · systems · all systems online · active events.
steps.watch_out: The numbers change as the simulation runs - that's fine.
